name: Asai Manami
source:
Manami is Masahiro's classmate, who was his classmates also back in junior high school. Her parents' house is a shinto shrine, so she often helps them out around the shrine, while wearing a miko's outfit.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050421021055fw_/http://home.att.ne.jp/blue/hironi/nirvana/natsusora.htm]Official Website[/url].]
